help.title: SWOP Help Center
help.subtitle: Practical guide for paper wallets, transfers and dApps without key custody.
help.quickText: SWOP is designed for short sessions: choose a network, open the wallet only when you need to operate, review every detail and close the app when finished. Work is preserved while switching sections; closing SWOP clears the local session.
help.vaultText: Vault generates paper wallets for the selected network. You can create one wallet or a batch, add a label and download public, private or complete documents. For maximum privacy, generate offline and store files offline.
help.sendText: Send opens a wallet with private key or recovery phrase. SWOP reads balances, estimates fees, supports MAX and signs the transaction on your device. Review network, destination, amount and fee before signing.
help.contractsText: DApps connects websites through WalletConnect. Open the wallet, scan or paste the QR and approve only requests you understand. SWOP displays messages, transactions, permissions and PSBTs when the network requires them.
help.scanText: SWOP Scan links your phone to desktop for scanning keys, phrases, addresses, contracts or WalletConnect QRs. The phone only sends data to the active field; it does not store keys or decide what to sign.
help.gasText: Each network charges its own fee: gas on contract networks, SOL on Solana and sats on Bitcoin. SWOP tries to estimate it before signing. If it is missing or strange, check connection, network and data first.
help.paperText: The paper wallet is a printable backup. The PNG keeps the brand design and the OCR TXT lets you read or copy the data. Any private or complete document gives access to funds: keep it offline.
help.securityText: The legend separates recognized tokens, tokens needing review and tokens marked dangerous. It is an aid, not automatic permission to sign or interact.
help.privacyText: SWOP is not designed to store sessions. While open it preserves work between tabs; when closed it clears language, keys, sessions and local storage to return to factory state.
help.guardText: Siade Guard protects subscribed users by blocking old or unauthorized versions and reducing the risk of altered copies.
help.guardPointVersion: Blocks old versions when an update is required.
help.guardPointIntegrity: Reduces the risk of using an altered copy.
help.guardPointSubscriber: Keeps SWOP aligned with the private subscriber environment.

help.offlineAnswer: This is a good moment to generate a wallet and save the backup without exposing your keys to the network. To read balances, detect tokens, calculate gas, and send transactions, SWOP needs access to the selected network.
